cohort: The study included fifty-one women who were diagnosed with Diastasis Recti Abdominis (DRA).
finding: Increased Inter-recti distance (IRD) is associated with worse postural control and better colorectal functions, but does not show a clear association with abdominal muscle endurance, pelvic floor functions, or respiratory muscle strength in women with DRA.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not determined to be a significant factor influencing Inter-recti distance (IRD) in women with DRA.
